concept.legendaryTitle: A legendary game turned global phenomenon
concept.legendaryP1After: , Yu-Gi-Oh! has thrilled duelists around the world. Born from a cult manga, the Yu-Gi-Oh! card game has become a
concept.legendaryP2: where every duel tells a story. Iconic summoning mechanics have shaped its identity —
concept.unbalancedText: Over time, the game grew more complex and the competitive scene turned uneven. Overpowered cards shorten duels, combos smother interaction, and "meta" decks cost a fortune.
concept.unbalancedResult: Result: Yu-Gi-Oh! is an unfair and expensive game, where fairness and fun both suffer
concept.visionTitle: Archetype Battle: an alternative format, a new vision
concept.visionText: Archetype Battle puts strategy back at the center. No need to spend a fortune: what matters is talent, creativity, and mastery of your archetype. The format slows the pace, favors tactical choices, and restores intensity to every duel.

1.title: Rule #1: Play with a single archetype
1.desc: Assert your playstyle identity and refine your combat style. Archetype Battle requires one archetype per deck. You cannot mix cards from multiple monster series in the same deck. Some archetype cards may be forbidden.

2.title: Rule #2: Play with a dedicated banlist
2.desc: Built to cut short abuses and astronomical card prices, the Archetype Battle banlist bans cards that are too powerful or too expensive

3.title: Rule #3: Play with a summon limit
3.desc: A redesigned tempo for smoother interactions and a calmer game read. The first turn is limited to 5 summons, then each following turn increases by 1 summon

concept.visionResult: Timing, resources, reading: brain and fun before the wallet
concept.ctaText: Explore archetypes, choose your side, and impose your style. Here, victory is earned through mastery and thinking.
